asks.note: Is my thesis on COST leaning on the fee rise too much?
asks.review: The renewal pillar is well tested; the expansion pillar has no figure behind it. Give it one: warehouses opened abroad a year, from the 10-K, at a level you would sell below. Your weights sit inside your own caps, and the record's streak shows the rules are kept.
